name: Joou Shachou no Boku Soudatsusen ~Karada mo Lead mo Yuzuranai! de, Docchi no ga Suki na no!?~
original_name: 女王社長の僕争奪戦 ～カラダもリードも譲らない！で、どっちのが好きなのっ！？～
source:
Katase Haruto is the young second-generation president of a company and the protagonist of this story. 

He is a beloved character among his employees, who describe him as a "cute little animal".

However, he himself is self-conscious about his unreliable appearance.

Suddenly, he experiences the biggest period of popularity in his life... or rather, the period of acquisitions!

Two beautiful female presidents from client companies have come forward to propose an M&A to his company!

The first is Tsuruma Isami, who looks like a fluffy, gentle type but is actually a go-getter!

She approaches him with sweet words like, "It's a diamond company, isn't it?" and invites him on dates (which are more like business meetings), making his heart race with her innocent (?) charm.

The second is Kugenuma Riko, a cool beauty feared as the "Empress".

She directly pushes for an acquisition, saying, "I don't like beating around the bush", but her  occasional clumsy moments are secretly loved by her employees.
Not to be outdone by Isami, she struggles to win Haruto over, but her efforts tend to backfire. 

Will Haruto be able to successfully sell his company?
And what will become of this strange love triangle with the two beautiful CEOs!?

[Edited from [url=https://www.dlsite.com/appx-touch/work/=/product_id/VJ01005110.html/]DLsite[/url]]
translation:
片濑晴人是一家公司的年轻二代社长，也是这个故事的主角。

他是员工们喜爱的角色，他们形容他是“可爱的小动物”。

然而，他本人却对自己外表的不可靠感到不自在。

突然，他经历了一生中最大的人气时期……或者说，收购时期！

客户公司的两位漂亮女总裁出面向他的公司提出并购！

第一个是鹤间勇，看似毛茸茸的温柔型，其实是个干练的人！

她用甜言蜜语接近他，比如“这是一家钻石公司，不是吗？”并邀请他约会（这更像是商务会议），让他因她天真（？）的魅力而心跳加速。

第二位是被称为“皇后”的冷酷美人鹧沼梨子。

她直言不讳地推动收购，称“我不喜欢拐弯抹角”，但她偶尔的笨拙时刻却被员工们暗暗喜爱。
她不甘示弱，努力争取春人的支持，但她的努力往往适得其反。

Haruto能够成功出售他的公司吗？
两位美丽总裁的奇怪三角恋又​​会变成什么样子呢！？
